usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds contacts and deal tasks, and SmartTask receives each “New Deal Task” as work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Task” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Task” in SmartTask
bestTemplate.why: Deal tasks created in the CRM show up where the team works, with no retyping.

watchOut: Pair “Deal Task Completed” with “Complete a Task”, not “Create Task”, or finishing work spawns a new task.
